title: Test code and implementation evidence
description: Read the test cases in tests/test_pipeline.py beside the implementation in src/pipeline.py. Explain the behavior asserted by the tests and trace each assertion to the implementation. A test file describes a check; it does not prove that check passed.

learning_objectives.text: Explain the source role and visible behavior in tests/test_pipeline.py, src/pipeline.py.
Trace a declaration, setting, or documented claim to a caller, test, or implementation path.
Separate source evidence, documentation claims, and unverified runtime behavior.

completion_criteria: Submit the code-trace exercise meeting all acceptance criteria.
